summary.text: Grok 4.20 is a language model in xAI's Grok line that takes text and images and returns text, first released as a beta in the Grok apps in February 2026 and on the xAI API in March 2026 as separate reasoning and non-reasoning models. xAI says it can run as a single agent or as several cooperating agents, offered as Grok 4.20 Multi-Agent.

changes.text: Can run as a single agent or as a multi-agent system in which several agents work on one request and a leader agent returns the final answer.

outputModalities.note: In the Grok apps the model can also call Grok Imagine to generate images (system card).

contextWindowTokens.note: API figure; requests above 200K prompt tokens are billed at a higher rate.

variants.note: Multi-agent deployment mode of Grok 4.20 (Grok 4.2 MA in the system card): several agents work on a request together and a leader agent returns the final answer; 4-agent and 16-agent setups. The Multi Agent guide says client-side function calling, custom tools and the Chat Completions API are not supported (built-in tools and remote MCP tools are), although the model page lists function calling.

notes: No x.ai news post exists for Grok 4.20 (x.ai/news/grok-4-20 returns 404); dates come from the grok.com release notes and the API release notes. The system card (April 7, 2026) says that as of writing the model was available through the consumer web and mobile apps, although the API release notes list it as live in March 2026. On the API it is offered as separate reasoning and non-reasoning model ids (grok-4.20-0309-reasoning, grok-4.20-0309-non-reasoning), kept as aliases. xAI materials also use Grok 4.2 (system card: Grok 4.2 SA and Grok 4.2 MA; Vertex AI guide), kept as a candidate alias. Many further beta aliases are listed on the docs page.
